# Skip the Rental

> A free hobby site that prices the same European trip twice: as a rental car and as car sharing, with every fee each side would actually charge. Prices are read nightly or checked by hand, and every page shows when. No ads, no affiliate links.

Run by Gabriel in Lithuania, through MB „Expat Mates“.

## Main pages

- [Trip calculator](https://skiptherental.com/): pick a city, dates and kilometres; see rental vs car sharing in euros
- [How we calculate](https://skiptherental.com/how-we-calculate.html): what is counted on each side and where the numbers come from
- [About](https://skiptherental.com/about.html): who runs the site, what is checked first-hand and how it is paid for
